description: Single-file virtual file manager over a localStorage filesystem: folder tree, breadcrumbs, create/rename/delete files and folders, move/copy, drag-and-drop upload from OS, text file viewer/editor with save, recursive search, storage usage meter.

criteria: vfs_file_manager_model_01.html is one self-contained file manager (no libraries): a hierarchical filesystem stored in localStorage with folders and text files, a tree panel plus breadcrumbs navigation, create/rename/delete for files and folders, move and copy including into other folders, drag-and-drop import of files from the operating system via dataTransfer plus a fallback upload button, an editor pane that opens text files and saves changes back, recursive search over names and file contents, download of a file, and a storage-usage meter against the localStorage quota. Path handling must be correct (no orphaned children after moves).
